issues.description: ABI/signature inconsistency for fix_add_asm: the NASM implementation in assignment/fix_add.asm treats the function as operating on two 64-bit fixed-point values passed as 4 stack dwords (a_low,a_high,b_low,b_high) and returns a 64-bit result in EDX:EAX, while the provided C test header and tests declare/call fix_add_asm as taking two fix_t arguments and returning a single fix_t (observing only EAX). This mismatch can lead students to implement a 64-bit EDX:EAX ABI (as suggested by the assembly) but the tests will pass only 32-bit arguments and check only a 32-bit return value, causing incorrect behavior or crashes.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify fix_add_asm to the ABI used by the tests: make it accept two fix_t parameters (stack [ebp+8] and [ebp+12]) and return a fix_t in EAX only, and update/remove the edx:eax-oriented demo code/comments in assignment/fix_add.asm. Alternatively, if 64-bit add is intended, change tests/src/fix_asm.h and tests/src/test.c to pass 64-bit values and validate the full 64-bit return (EDX:EAX) consistently.
